svg.aria-label: One run over nine turns. System 2 calls its tools directly; the guard sits beside the path, optional and off by default. At turn 2 System 2 searches with decision_code or decision_files: System 1 walks the index and returns ranked places. Every turn goes into the journal. At turn 4 System 1 reads the session cut, built by code, and calls the turns advancing; at turn 8 it calls them stuck, looks again at turn 9, still stuck, and nudges System 2. When System 2's context passes the threshold, the turns fold into the State, written as edits, beside the reads System 1 kept.
svg.text: the session cut, built by code
nudge: act on what you found
turns 1-9 → State (edits) + the reads System 1 kept
